have he : (fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖KdVPlan.S t f k‖^2) = (fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k*‖f k‖^2) := by

exact ⟨by simpa only [KdVPlan.MemH, he] using hf, by simp only [KdVPlan.hn, he]⟩
